title: CutIGA with Least Squares Stabilized Nitsche Boundary Conditions: The Biharmonic Problem
summary: We propose a symmetric Nitsche method for the biharmonic Dirichlet problem on a smooth domain whose boundary may cut arbitrarily through the computational mesh. Bulk least-squares stabilization in a boundary strip and tangential boundary penalties control the consistency terms through an explicit lifting of the two Dirichlet traces. This gives coercivity on $H^4(Ω)$ without inverse inequalities and permits a fixed penalty independent of the cut configuration for sufficiently thin strips.
